ops.title: P7 adversarial-verify findings — full triage (6 lanes, 5 repos)
ops.body:
P7 ran 6 parallel codex refuter lanes over the shipped build (cc-runtime c9c8445c, synckit v0.17.0, cc-present ba07a1e3, cc-interact 9e2a7fb/v0.9.1, cc-orchestrate 7bc5a09). Provenance: lanes audited c9c8445c; real cc-runtime HEAD 2a1f36f is +2 guide/config chores (source untouched), so findings are valid against shipped code. 2 blockers, 15 majors, several minors. Triage:

**BUCKET A — clear in-scope defects, fix now:**
- A1 [mesh blocker] `cc-runtime rpc --json '<literal>'` still accepts payload on argv (the fan-out uses `--json -`/stdin, but the CLI surface allows argv); invalid-stdin echoed verbatim into error → over SSH → logs. Undermines the finding-#9 "resolved" claim. Fix: make rpc stdin-only, redact payload from the invalid-JSON error. [cc-runtime runtime/rpc.go]
- A2 [parity major / trust minor] meshtrust parse.go build() keys peers by normalizeHost(DNSName) into a Go map — colliding names → nondeterministic winner across processes (reproduced 4096×). Breaks parity. Fix: sort/fail-closed on collision. [synckit meshtrust]
- A3 [tools major] wrap splitToolList: an unbalanced '(' in a caller --disallowedTools value swallows commas, collapsing 4 deny entries into 1 malformed rule → native tools not reliably disabled. Fix: fail loud / handle unbalanced. [cc-runtime runtime/wrap.go]
- A4 [liveness major] respawnAgent not atomic across b.Spawn+setAgentIncarnation: persist failure after a successful spawn leaks the new terminal (h2 untracked). Fix: kill h2 on persist error. [cc-orchestrate]
- A5 [trust major] cc-present has no RequireJSON gate on tokenless-reachable state-changing POSTs (/api/interactions, /api/assets) — same CSRF surface cc-runtime hardened. Fix: mirror RequireJSON. [cc-present]
- A6 [access major] APNs error paths embed the device token → logged verbatim (runtime/push.go:80). Fix: redact token from error/log. [cc-runtime]
- A7 [tools minor] ask/notify schema: no minItems on options, no required prompt/message — empty question gate-blocks on nothing. Fix: schema+handler validation. [cc-runtime]
- A8 [mesh major] hostadd non-atomicity (finding #6) is NOT actually documented anywhere despite the "documented, not regressed" claim. Fix: document honestly (comment+CHANGELOG) or add rollback. [cc-runtime]

**BUCKET B — client-side, refute load-bearing invariants, pre-existing (iOS/web):**
- B1 [access blocker] iOS EndpointProber attaches bearer to any URL with no scheme/https/port validation → http:// leaks token cleartext on LAN; fp made optional in Swift decoder (system-trust fallback for IP-literal hosts) vs Go always emitting fp. [iOS CcRuntimeKit]
- B2 [access] web token.ts puts bearer as `?token=` EventSource query param (EventSource can't set headers — known limitation); `cc-runtime pair` prints token to stdout (QR source, redirectable to a log).

**BUCKET C — architectural / product / latent, need a decision:**
- C1 [trust major] SSE /events authorized once at accept — an open stream keeps flowing after registry-drop / non-Running backend / meshtrust fail-closed. Second unbounded stale-trust window beyond the 30s TTL. Bounded in practice by tailnet-layer revocation (WireGuard stops routing a dropped peer), but registry-only revocation leaves the window. Upstream cc-interact (affects both consumers).
- C2 [liveness major] child.launcher that forks/detaches Claude and exits 0 → bogus nonce-matched childExited kills a live session; report path has no prober corroboration. Our shipped launcher (wrap) execs (safe), but the contract is undocumented.
- C3 [liveness major] no UNIQUE(session_id); restore-bundle can dup a session → getAgentBySession unordered → nonce miss → degrade to fallback. A 4th residual beyond the documented three.
- C4 [liveness major] (session,scope) PID-mutability: two live claude sharing (session,scope) rebind the subject by PID → shared edit-gate state. Same-daemon (cc-runtime), not cross-daemon. Edge case (manual `wrap -- claude --resume S` in an orchestrated scope).
- C5 [access major] subscription cap (32) TOCTOU: SELECT count → INSERT non-atomic → concurrent overshoot. Low impact.
- C6 [mesh major] ConnectTimeout=3 is per-address not per-host (N dead addrs → N×3s serial); failover only on ssh exit 255 (a connect-but-exit-1 stale addr never retried); notify leg (SSHOnce) never DialAddrs. Refines findings #7/#8.
- C7 [access] prompt/notification text placed verbatim into APNs/WebPush payloads → reaches Apple + lock screen. Product decision (notification context is the point).

**REJECTED:**
- [mesh major] pair-mode LAN(:25444)/tailnet(:25443) TLS listeners + Bonjour "beyond loopback+meshtrust": these ARE the intentional access plane (P2), opt-in via `pair`, predate mesh work. The PC "no new mesh listeners" claim holds; the P7 claim wording was over-broad. Not a defect.
- [tools minor] wrapHead trusts executable basename: caller chooses the executable (intended threat model).
- [parity minor] independent 30s Provider caches → ≤30s divergence: inherent to per-process caching, not a defect.
